source.source_name: BODACC — Bulletin officiel des annonces civiles et commerciales

pagination.note: Records API caps offset (~10000); for full history use the exports endpoint or filter by dateparution windows.

snapshot.note: Harvest incrementally by dateparution; or full via exports/json. Persist raw events.

parsing.notes: Extract 9-digit SIREN from 'registre' to join. familleavis_lib classifies the event. jugement/depot are nested objects (insolvency / accounts-filing). Not a master list — events only.

mapping_rules.events: familleavis_lib + dateparution + jugement/depot -> lifecycle event records.
mapping_rules.financial_refresh: Dépôt des comptes (depot) -> trigger inpi_comptes_annuels refresh for the SIREN.

fixture_requirements: Dépôt des comptes with depot block

live_test_plan.smoke: GET records?limit=2; assert total_count and results[].familleavis_lib present.
live_test_plan.full: Harvest by dateparution windows (or exports/json) behind an env gate; parse SIREN; attach events to the spine; trigger financial refresh on dépôt des comptes.

blockers: Records API offset cap — use date windows or the exports endpoint for full history.
registre parsing needed to recover SIREN (not always clean).
